scope_statement: Add deterministic PRD/ADR acceptance metadata validation and ADR supersession link checks to product workflow parsing, lint, and audit without adding model acceptance authority.

commands: idiom tool context_pack --input '{"task":"phase 3 acceptance state and supersession links for PRD ADR product workflow","mode":"plan","limit":12}'

idiom tool context_query --input '{"query":"ValidateArtifactState ADR acceptance metadata accepted_at accepted_by acceptance_profile superseded_by supersedes PRD ADR audit product workflow","resolution":"symbol"}'
JSON/JSONL validation for durable impl-0025 artifacts
privacy secret-pattern scan over durable impl-0025 artifacts

privacy_note: durable reports and workflow state store only acceptance/supersession contract metadata, path identifiers, command names, and typed findings; they do not store raw prompts, raw transcripts, file bodies, secrets, or customer-identifying data
